debate.key_bear_argument: Earnings in 3 days present critical binary risk, macro environment is crisis-level (VIX 396.8, rising dollar, flat yield curve), long-term trend is broken (EMA 50/200 bearish, price below 200EMA), and momentum exhaustion signals (stochRSI oversold, no active crossovers) suggest fading conviction.
